I will keep this small maize plot close to what worked for me before. Because the plot is only 0.14 hectares, I will not buy much chemical fertilizer on its own, but if I can share a bag with another farmer I will put a little, and I will also carry manure from home because this land is mine. I will plant improved seed if I get a small packet, but I will not spend money on pesticide, and I will wait for the rains instead of irrigating.
